001package dev.nandi0813.api.Enum;
002
003/**
004 * The state of a player in ZonePractice Pro.
005 */
006public enum PlayerState {
007
008    /** The player is offline. */
009    OFFLINE,
010    /** The player is in the lobby. */
011    LOBBY,
012    /** The player is editing a ladder kit. */
013    EDITOR,
014    /** The player is editing a custom kit. */
015    CUSTOM_EDITOR,
016    /** The player is in a match queue. */
017    QUEUE,
018    /** The player fights in a match. */
019    MATCH,
020    /** The player fights in an FFA. */
021    FFA,
022    /** The player is in an event. */
023    EVENT,
024    /** The player spectates a match, FFA or event. */
025    SPECTATE,
026    /** The player is in staff mode. */
027    STAFF_MODE,
028    /** Profile not loaded, or a state added by a newer core version. */
029    UNKNOWN;
030
031    /**
032     * Check whether this state is a fighting state.
033     * @return true for MATCH, FFA and EVENT.
034     */
035    public boolean isFighting() {
036        return this == MATCH || this == FFA || this == EVENT;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * Check whether this state is a lobby state.
041     * @return true for LOBBY and STAFF_MODE.
042     */
043    public boolean isInLobby() {
044        return this == LOBBY || this == STAFF_MODE;
045    }
046
047}
